[[Loronar Corporation/Legends|Loronar Corporation]] manufactured a '''landing sphere''' was used with their [[SkyBlind]] reconnaissance [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. It was used as a ship to surface transport for the SkyBlind. Although only measuring six [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length, it could accommodate the entire crew and passengers of the SkyBlind, as well as five [[Metric ton/Legends|metric tons]] of cargo. It was powered by [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] engines, and was both airtight and [[Water/Legends|water]] resistant. However, it could not travel far from a source of [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]], such as a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Not all SkyBlinds carried landing spheres; if the sphere was not present aboard a SkyBlind, the ship's cargo capacity was doubled.
